messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from last night's SLO incident — we decided to add incident-driven tests (regression promptsets, load variations, and a chaos drill). Kicking off triage and owner assignments here.

Jonah: Can we list what gaps we saw? I can own the regression harness integration.

Samir: I pulled the postmortem artifact w/ failing prompt examples: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/incident-1988-prompts — there are ~12 prompts that regress occasionally.

Lia: I'll add load-test variants to the existing perf job (increase concurrency + longer seqs). Also volunteer to run the chaos drill during off-peak. ETA 2w for infra changes.

Maya: Proposed owners/timelines: Samir -> promptset curation + golden outputs (2w), Jonah -> regression harness + CI gating (1w), Lia -> load-test configs + chaos drill runbook (2w). I'll own tracking and weekly follow-ups.

Jonah: Where should new tests live? is there a canonical repo/path?

Samir: Use infra/evals/regression in monorepo. PR template suggestion below (paste to the PR body):
```
- Purpose: add incident-driven promptset N
- Acceptance: no >3% quality drop on core promptsets; P95 latency +15% cap for 0-512 tokens
- Owner: @Samir
- Test command: ./ci/run-regression --promptset incident-1988
```

OpsBot: New ticket created: RD-3456 "Incident-driven evals: postmortem 1988" — linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Lia: Scheduling a 30m sync Wed 10:00 to unblock infra changes. @Samir @Jonah please confirm.

Jonah: Confirmed. I'll push a skeleton PR today and wire up CI steps. @Maya can you add the acceptance criteria to RD-3456?

Maya: Added acceptance criteria in the ticket: quality/regression thresholds + latency SLOs. Also added link to postmortem and failing examples.

Samir: Note: we need updated golden outputs for multi-turn convo flows; I'll spin a data-capture job and attach artifacts to the ticket.

Lia: I'll run a one-off chaos run (network partition + model fallback) next Thursday off-peak and post the results.

Maya: Thanks — I'll run weekly check-ins and mark these as recurring until we see no regressions for 4 consecutive runs. :thumbsup:

Jonah: Quick question — do we want automated alerts if regression CI fails? I suggest auto-create a P1 draft for the owners when quality delta > 2.5%.

Maya: Yes, good idea. I'll add webhook -> PagerDuty draft in RD-3456 as an optional escalation.

Samir: One more: capture seed/weights for the run so we can reproduce. I'll include that in the PR checklist.

Lia: Great. See you all Wed.

Maya: Closing loop: owners assigned (Samir/Jonah/Lia), tickets created (RD-3456), sync Wed 10am, follow-ups weekly. If anything blocks earlier ping me or drop a quick thread here.
